system.description: When a Successful direct (non-Area) Attack is about to damage an ally, you leap in and take the damage instead. You must be adjacent to that ally but can take a 10ft Step before using this Skill to get into position. You take the damage. You can't use Evade, Shield Block, and other Skills or Spells to negate damage dealt to you this way.

upgrades.description: You've learned how to take hits. You gain +5 DR when using this Skill.
